description: This file defines an abstract utility class JwtHelper for generating and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs). It provides methods to configure signing and verification keys, create tokens, and check token expiration. The class supports different signing algorithms based on key types (shared secret, RSA, EC) and includes methods for common JWT operations such as extracting claims and checking expiration.

classes.name: JwtHelper
classes.description: An abstract utility class for creating and validating JWT tokens, supporting different key types and signing algorithms, with methods for token expiration checks and claim retrieval.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Converts a string secret into a UTF-8 encoded byte array.

methods.name: setSharedSecret
methods.description: Sets the secret key used for signing tokens, requiring at least 32 bytes.

methods.name: setPrivateKey
methods.description: Loads an RSA or EC private key from a file for signing tokens.

methods.name: setPublicKey
methods.description: Loads a public key from a certificate file for verifying tokens.

methods.name: getTokenLifetime
methods.description: Returns the Duration used to set the expiration claim ('exp') of tokens.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a JWT token is expired based on current time or a specified instant.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Extracts the expiration date ('exp' claim) from a JWT token.

methods.name: forSharedSecret
methods.description: Creates a JwtHelper configured for signing/verifying with a shared secret.

methods.name: forSigning
methods.description: Creates a JwtHelper configured for signing JWTs using provided key material.

methods.name: forValidating
methods.description: Creates a JwtHelper configured for validating JWTs using provided key material.
